summary: Petition under section 17(3) and 17(4) of the electricity act, 2003 read with regulation 6(8) of the central electricity regulatory commission (procedure, terms and conditions for grant of transmission licence and other related matters) regulations, 2024 and article 15.2 of the transmission service agreement dated 06.11.2024 seeking approval of the commission for creating charge over the assets (immovable & movable), licenses/permits/approvals, current assets and bank accounts of the petitioner in favour of national bank for financing infrastructure and developments. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation of a security over the Petitioner’s assets, including all movable and immovable assets, in (c) _Pass any such further order(s) as this Commission may deem and appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the present case.”_ 4. In terms of the provisions of the Facility Agreement, the Petitioner has submitted that it is required to create a security interest, _inter alia_ , as follows: - _(i) all the rights, title, interest, benefits, claim and demands whatsoever of the Borrower in the Project Documents, in the Clearances; loss protection covers under the Insurance Contracts etc., wherever the same is permitted;_ 5. The Petitioner has submitted that the Petitioner has a right to create a charge over the Transmission Project assets in accordance with Article 15.2.2 of the TSA, which provides that the Petitioner may create any charge over all or part of the receivables, or the Project Assets of the Project in favour of the Lender or the Lender's representative on their behalf, as security for amounts payable under the Financing Agreements and any other amounts agreed by the Parties, subject to conditions mentioned in the TSA. Accordingly, the charge created over the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of the Security Trustee is in accordance with Article 15.2.2 of the TSA dated 6.11.2024. 6. The Petitioner has further submitted that in terms of Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Act, the Petitioner is required to seek prior approval of this Commission for obtaining necessary approvals for the creation of charge. Considering the documents/ information submitted accompanying the present Petition, the Petitioner has complied with the statutory requirements under Section 17 (3) and (4) of the Act. Hence, the present Petition has been filed by the Petitioner seeking approval of the Commission for creation of charge by the Petitioner over the Petitioner’s Assets in favour of Respondent No. 21 7. The Petitioner has submitted that Section 17(3) read with Article 15 of the TSA provides that prior approval is to be sought from the Appropriate Commission for creating security over the assets. Further, the TSA executed between the parties specifically provides that this Commission is the Appropriate Commission for the purpose of seeking the requisite approvals under the Act, and the TSA, as the Project of the Petitioner is an ISTS, therefore, this Commission has the requisite jurisdiction to grant approval under Section 17(3) of the Act. 8. The matter was admitted on 30.7.2026, and notices were issued to the parties to file their respective replies. 9. During the hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that no reply has been filed by the Respondents despite service of notice. It was further submitted that, under the Facility Agreement, the Petitioner is required to obtain the said approval by November 2026 and, accordingly, requested that the Petition be decided expeditiously. After hearing learned counsel for the Petitioner, the matter was reserved for orders. 10. We have considered the submissions made by the Petitioner and perused the material available on record. The Petitioner has entered into the Facility Agreement dated 1.8.2025 with the Lender to avail financial assistance aggregating Rs. 1805.00 crore for the implementation of the Transmission Project. Further, the Lender entered into a Safe Keeping Agreement dated 1.8.2025 wherein it appointed Respondent No. 11. The Petitioner, vide the Facility Agreement, has furnished the estimated project cost and financial plan as on the date of execution of the Facility Agreement, as detailed 13. The Petitioner has submitted that it is permitted to create encumbrances over Project Assets in accordance with Article 15 of the TSA. Under Article 15.2.2 of the TSA, the Petitioner may create any encumbrance over all or part of the receivables, or _i. the Lenders or the lenders' Representative on their behalf shall have entered into the Financing Agreements and agreed in writing to the provisions of this Agreement; and_ _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ _(4) Any agreement relating to any transaction specified in sub-section (1) or subsection (3), unless made with the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission, shall be void_ .” approval for assigning its licence or transferring its utility or any part thereof by way of sale, lease, exchange or otherwise and entering into an agreement relating to any of these transactions. Accordingly, we accord approval to the Petitioner for the creation of a security over the Petitioner’s assets, including all movable and immovable assets, in favour of SBICAP Trustee Company Limited, i.e., Respondent No. 21 for the benefit of lender NaBFID, i.e., Respondent No. 20, by way of mortgage or any other security document over the project assets by execution of an indenture of Mortgage and financing documents of the Project. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution. needed.
